title: TSM Tri-State River Valley Authoritative Data Fabric

scope.description: Community-scale Ohio-Wabash confluence and connected Lower Wabash river valley. Coverage is AOI/HUC/river-reach driven rather than a private-property anchor.
scope.vertical_datum_policy: NAVD88 is explicit metadata; EPSG:2966 alone does not establish a vertical datum.

portalPages.role: interactive viewer / WMS-oriented portal; not a bulk data archive
interactive search / discovery UI; not a stable machine-readable query endpoint

sources.machineReadableAccess: ArcGIS REST MapServer; use layer metadata and spatially bounded query operations. Portal UI failures do not establish REST service failure.

sources.dataset: Overture Maps buildings theme (global vector feature data)
sources.acquisitionMethod: Official overturemaps Python CLI; mandatory bounded bbox for AOI jobs; never download all global feature types by default.
sources.repoStatus: Existing Posey extract and shard manifests are present in data/overture; data/overture/README.md records the release used by those extracts.
sources.releasePolicy: Record CLI version, STAC/release identifier, exact bbox, retrieval time, command, content hash, and licence for each new acquisition; latest STAC release may change.
limitations: Community vector context, not a survey or government authority.
Building height attributes are not assumed to be surveyed heights.
Global parquet shards are not mirrored into standard Git.

sources.authority: Indiana Geographic Information Office / USGS 3DEP program / Indiana Spatial Data Portal
sources.dataset: Indiana statewide QL2 LiDAR and derived elevation, 2016-2020
sources.vintage: 2016-2020 acquisition program; source page lists Posey, Vanderburgh, and Warrick among 2020 counties.
sources.horizontalCrsPolicy: Use per-county/per-product metadata. Indiana State Plane East is EPSG:2965; Indiana State Plane West is EPSG:2966; both use US survey feet in the ISDP description.
sources.verticalDatumPolicy: Do not infer a vertical datum from EPSG:2965/2966 alone; preserve each specific product's metadata and verify actual file headers before combining.
sources.license: CC0/public domain as stated by the Indiana LiDAR portal for the listed 3DEP products; retain origin attribution and product metadata.
sources.repoStatus: Partially present: data-sources/manifests/indiana-dem-2020.json inventories 581 per-tile references; one Posey 2.5-ft DEM tile and small derivatives are committed. The countywide DEM is not vendored wholesale.
limitations: The portal notes some metadata/vertical-accuracy review may lag acquisition.
A DEM is not a survey certification and does not provide submerged channel bathymetry.
Download only tiles intersecting an approved AOI and necessary buffer.

sources.dataset: Countywide LiDAR and DEM tile discovery catalogue
limitations: Use linked product-level metadata and direct tile artifacts as source records; the portal listing alone is not an acquired dataset.

sources.authority: NOAA Office for Coastal Management; source data contributed by Indiana Department of Natural Resources
geographicCoverage: Lake, LaPorte, and Porter Counties, Indiana
sources.metadataSpatialReference: NOAA's direct S3 index identifies NAD83(HARN) / UTM Zone 16N horizontally and NAVD88 using GEOID18 in metres vertically; verify each downloaded file's LAS/LAZ header and metadata before use.
sources.accessPolicy: The OpenTopography web page reports eligibility restrictions (US academic .edu, certain educators by application, or OpenTopography+). The NOAA S3 metadata index is a separate direct distribution route.
sources.license: Record exact product-level use constraints from source metadata before redistributing derived files.
limitations: The dataset footprint is in northwest Indiana/northeast Illinois/southwest Michigan, not the current Posey/Lower Wabash-Ohio pilot area.
Do not pull the entire approximately 24 GB dataset unless a verified AOI intersects the footprint.
The OpenTopography overview has an original-product CRS description that differs from the S3 index's spatial-reference section; actual tile metadata must control.

ingestion_rules.browser_runtime: consume provenance-controlled tiles/services; never silently promote source data to engineering determinations
ingestion_rules.regulatory_layers: retain source authority and effective status
